stances.summary: Warns of Iranian interference before Israeli and US elections
stances.quote:
The October surprise was born in Iran. Forty-six years later, the Islamic Republic may be preparing another.

Israel votes Oct. 27. U.S. midterms follow Nov. 3—exactly one week later.

That makes late October a potentially dangerous window for regime mischief.
